notes.publicLibraries: Count of items typed 'public library' in Wikidata. Coverage varies enormously by country's cataloguing activity; treat as a floor, not a census.
notes.topUniversities: CWUR World University Rankings 2026 national ranks; countries with fewer than 10 ranked institutions list what is ranked.
